# Agent Python Tools

## File: open-webui_openapi-servers/servers/time-ui/main.py

Prompts

```
['run a fastapi server that provides UTC and local time retrieval endpoints', 'build a fastapi endpoint that formats the current time using a custom strftime pattern and timezone', 'create a fastapi endpoint that converts an ISO 8601 timestamp between two IANA timezones', 'test the fastapi endpoint that parses flexible timestamp strings and normalizes them to UTC', 'review the fastapi endpoint that returns all valid IANA timezone names as an HTML list']
```

Usage

```
{'run_fastapi_time_server': 'run a fastapi server that provides UTC and local time retrieval endpoints', 'build_format_time_endpoint': 'build a fastapi endpoint that formats the current time using a custom strftime pattern and timezone', 'create_convert_time_endpoint': 'create a fastapi endpoint that converts an ISO 8601 timestamp between two IANA timezones', 'test_parse_timestamp_endpoint': 'test the fastapi endpoint that parses flexible timestamp strings and normalizes them to UTC', 'review_list_time_zones_endpoint': 'review the fastapi endpoint that returns all valid IANA timezone names as an HTML list'}
```
